name: handoff
description: Writes HANDOFF.md from the session transcript on /handoff, at session end, or when a long chat offers it; the next session in that folder, or this one after /clear, picks it up.

file.title: Handoff file
file.description: Path of the handoff file, relative to the session's folder

autoOnEnd.title: Write at session end
autoOnEnd.description: Write the handoff automatically when the session ends (not on /clear)

minTurns.title: Minimum turns
minTurns.description: Sessions with fewer completed turns are not worth a handoff

offerAtPercent.title: Offer at (% of context)
offerAtPercent.description: Offer a handoff above the prompt once the context is this full, as a percent of its window; 0 never offers
